passage:
**Business permit applications received by a town office, January to May 2025**

| Month | New | Renewal |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| January | 35 | 120 |
| February | 40 | 60 |
| March | 25 | 45 |
| April | 30 | 30 |
| May | 50 | 20 |
stem: In which month did the office receive the most new applications?
hints: The table has two columns of numbers. The question asks only about new applications.
Read down the New column and find the largest number.
Read across from that largest number to the month on the same row.

solution.methodName: Read the title and units, then find the row and column

steps.why: The Renewal column counts a different kind of application, so leave it out.

steps.action: The largest number in the New column is 50.
Read across to the month on the same row: May.
The office received the most new applications in May.

trapNotes.January: January has the most renewals (120), not the most new applications. In the New column, January has only 35.
trapNotes.February: February has 40 new applications, the second largest. May has more, with 50.
trapNotes.March: March has the fewest new applications (25), not the most.
